name: The Algaz Gauntlet
summary: At Dun Algaz, orcs have seized the pass between Loch Modan and the Wetlands. The Dragonmaw threaten Ironforge's route to Menethil Harbor, so Mountaineer Rockgar sends Alliance travelers to strike them and carry word to Valstag Ironjaw.

sections.title: A Severed Artery
sections.body:
Crags divide Loch Modan from the Wetlands, and Dun Algaz is the way across. It is the only overland mountain pass between them, and Ironforge depends on it for trade, troop movements, and supplies bound for Menethil Harbor, the Alliance's main coastal port in the region.

If the pass falls, Ironforge loses its route to the western seas. Isolated outposts would also lose access to dwarven reinforcements.

sections.title: The Dragonmaw Surge
sections.body:
Dragonmaw remnants have haunted the hills and ruins of the Wetlands since the Second War. Now they have pushed into Dun Algaz in an organized assault, seizing the tunnels and fortifying the pass with their scouts and grunts.

Mountaineer Rockgar asks Alliance travelers to slay the orcs and carry word of the attack to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why is Dun Algaz so important to the Alliance?
faq.answer: Dun Algaz is the only direct mountain route between Loch Modan and the Wetlands. It connects the heart of Khaz Modan to Menethil Harbor, the main Alliance port for sea travel.

faq.q: Who are the Dragonmaw orcs occupying the pass?
aliases: why are orcs in dun algaz
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw are remnants of the Old Horde, known for enslaving red dragons during the Second War. After their defeat, scattered factions retreated into the Wetlands. Now they have pushed south into the pass to seize its strategic choke points.

aliases: where do i go after algaz gauntlet
faq.answer: After you fight through the pass and slay the grunts and scouts, the road leads north through the Wetlands. At the fork, take the western road to Menethil Harbor and report to Valstag Ironjaw.

faq.q: Why is Valstag Ironjaw surprised by the report?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw usually keep to hidden camps in the marshy hills of the Wetlands. Their bold push into the dwarven tunnels of Dun Algaz marks an unexpected turn toward organized aggression.

faq.q: Who orders the assault on the pass?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Rockgar, a dwarven guard at Loch Modan's northern border, orders the strike. He wants to stop the orcs from securing their foothold and cutting off communication with the coast.

faq.q: What comes after completing this gauntlet?
faq.answer: Your report to Valstag Ironjaw alerts the Menethil Harbor garrison to the immediate threat. It opens further chances to aid the dwarven defense against the Dragonmaw in the Wetlands.

angles.text: As a dwarf, clearing Dun Algaz protects Khaz Modan's ancestral mountain passes and keeps the route between Ironforge and its western sea harbor open.
As an Alliance member, Menethil Harbor is your main gateway between the Eastern Kingdoms and western lands. Keeping the overland route clear matters to the whole Alliance.
